Role

Lead Customer Success Engineer (UKG Ready)

Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Lead Customer Success Engineer will serve as a senior technical advisor, product enablement leader, and customer intelligence partner for the India Customer Success organization. This role partners closely with CSMs to improve customer outcomes through technical guidance, product adoption strategies, scalable education, and data-driven risk identification.
  
  
A core focus of this role is helping CSMs confidently speak to the value of UKG products and newly released features. The Lead CSE will create practical enablement assets, demo experiences, talk tracks, and field-ready guidance that allow CSMs to connect capabilities to customer business outcomes in both 1:1 and 1:many settings.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Partner with CSMs to understand customer business objectives, technical challenges, adoption gaps, and opportunities to leverage UKG capabilities more effectively.
* Provide architecture and technical guidance across configuration, integrations, data models, APIs, security, governance, and product best practices.
* Lead technical discovery, solution reviews, adoption workshops, and customer-facing product discussions when Success Engineering support is required.
* Analyze customer health, Compass signals, adoption data, support trends, renewal information, and product usage indicators to identify accounts needing CSE attention.
* Translate data insights into clear recommendations for CSMs, including suggested outreach, product adoption plays, enablement opportunities, and risk mitigation actions.
* Mentor Senior Customer Success Engineers and help establish standards for technical assessments, product enablement, risk analysis, and reusable content.

Product Enablement & Content Creation Responsibilities
  

* Own the design and production of scalable product enablement for the CS organization, including short-form demo videos, feature walkthroughs, webinar decks, technical explainers, customer-ready talk tracks, and CSM coaching guides.
* Build demo libraries organized by product area, customer outcome, persona, and use case so CSMs can quickly show how UKG functionality supports business value.
* Translate new product releases into CS-ready enablement packages that explain what changed, why it matters, which customers benefit, how to position the value, and what CSMs should listen for in customer conversations.
* Host recurring enablement webinars, office hours, and product deep-dive sessions that help CSMs understand releases, adoption opportunities, common objections, and value-based messaging.
* Create CSM-facing value narratives that connect product capabilities to outcomes such as adoption, efficiency, compliance, employee experience, retention, payroll accuracy, workforce optimization, and operational scale.
* Package repeatable product adoption plays and success accelerators that CSMs can use in Success Plans, renewal preparation, risk mitigation, and customer business reviews.
* Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Support, Services, and Enablement to ensure CS teams receive timely, accurate, and practical product readiness content.

  
Qualifications
  

* 7+ years of experience implementing, consulting on, supporting, or advising customers on UKG products.
* Deep expertise in one or more UKG solution areas such as Pro, WFM, Ready, Talent, Payroll, Reporting, Integrations, or Security.
* Strong ability to connect product capability, technical design, customer goals, and measurable business outcomes.
* Experience creating demos, webinars, enablement materials, product guides, or technical content for customer-facing teams.
* Excellent facilitation and presentation skills with the ability to engage CSMs, customer executives, technical stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.
* Strong analytical skills and experience interpreting customer health, adoption, support, telemetry, or renewal signals.
* Experience with Gainsight, Compass, Power BI, Salesforce, SQL, telemetry, or customer intelligence tools preferred.

  
Success Measures
  

* CSMs can clearly articulate the value of UKG products and new features using consistent talk tracks and practical examples.
* Enablement assets are reusable, field-ready, and adopted by India CS and broader Customer Success teams.
* CSE recommendations help CSMs prioritize the right accounts, risks, and adoption opportunities.
* Product release readiness improves across CS through timely, relevant, outcome-oriented enablement.

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. title: Senior Manager, Test Engineering- Networking background is a must
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly experienced **Senior QA Manager** to own end-to-end quality for **SonicOS**, the core operating system powering SonicWall's next-generation firewall products. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will define quality strategy, drive automation and test infrastructure investments, and partner closely with Product Management, Development, Release Engineering, DevOps, and Support teams to ensure every release meets high standards of reliability, security, and customer trust.

You will be responsible not just for test execution, but for shaping how quality is built into the product lifecycle — from early design reviews and threat modelling to release readiness and post-release learning.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Strategy & Release Ownership**

* Define and continuously improve the QA strategy for SonicOS across major releases, patches, and hotfixes
* Establish quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and clear release readiness standards
* Drive risk-based testing and shift-left practices to catch issues early
* Own go/no-go decisions for releases from a quality standpoint

**Firewall Domain & Technical Leadership**

* Provide strong technical leadership across firewall features such as:
* + Stateful firewall, NAT, VPN (IPSec/SSL), routing, HA
  + Security services like IPS, DPI-SSL, Gateway AV, App Control, Web Filtering
* Review PRDs, design documents, and architecture proposals with a quality & security mindset
* Define comprehensive test strategies covering:
* + Functional correctness and complex E2E customer workflows
  + Performance, scale, and stress (throughput, sessions, DPI impact)
  + HA failover, upgrades/downgrades, config migrations, and long-run stability
* Champion security and negative testing to validate abuse cases and threat scenarios

**Automation, CI/CD & Test Infrastructure**

* Define the long-term automation vision (UI, API, CLI, E2E) and measurable coverage goals
* Partner with automation leads to build scalable, reliable frameworks integrated into CI/CD
* Drive stability and reliability of automated test suites (reduce flakiness, improve signal)
* Own strategy for testbeds spanning hardware appliances, virtual firewalls, and cloud deployments
* Work with infra teams to ensure availability, capacity planning, and reliability of test environments

**Execution Excellence & Metrics**

* Own and track key quality metrics: defect leakage, escape rate, regression effectiveness, automation ROI, flakiness trends
* Lead regular release readiness and quality reviews with senior stakeholders
* Drive deep root cause analysis for production escapes and systemic quality gaps
* Convert learnings from field issues into preventive quality improvements

**People Leadership & Stakeholder Influence**

* Build, mentor, and retain a strong leadership bench of QA managers, leads, and senior engineers
* Set clear expectations, career paths, and technical growth plans for the QA organization
* Influence engineering leadership and PMs to prioritize quality, reliability, and customer impact
* Represent QA in leadership forums, customer escalations, and cross-functional reviews

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of total technical experience, including at least 2+ years in a management or leadership role
* Strong background in testing firewall / network security products or similar system software
* Deep understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, NAT, VPN, HA, IPS/DPI concepts, authentication mechanisms)
* Experience owning quality for complex, large-scale system software releases
* Proven leadership experience managing and scaling QA teams across geographies
* Strong exposure to automation strategy and CI/CD-driven quality practices
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholders

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience with SonicOS or comparable firewall OS platforms
* Exposure to security compliance programs (FIPS, Common Criteria, SOC2)
* Experience testing in hybrid environments (hardware + virtual + cloud)
* Experience handling customer escalations and field issue RCA

**What Success Looks Like**

* Predictable, high-quality SonicOS releases with reduced Sev1/Sev2 customer issues
* Measurable improvement in automation coverage and test effectiveness
* Faster feedback cycles for Dev and PM through shift-left and CI/CD integration
* Strong QA leadership bench and high team engagement
* Improved customer trust and reduced critical escalations

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. You’ll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You’ll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone’s own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product.

The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company’s future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life.

This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.

  

**Scope and Decision Rights:**

* **You own:** Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators.
* **You partner on:** enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams).
  

**In this role, you will…**

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management*

* Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function.
* Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost.
* Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly.
* Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms.
* Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language.

*Architecture & Standards*

* Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice.
* Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval.
* Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue.
* Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience.

*AI-Powered Experiences*

* Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified.
* Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams.
* Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring.
* Design for an agentic future, including integration through emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and partner agent ecosystems.

*Integration & Execution*

* Own and drive the integrations between the learning ecosystem including Cornerstone platform, Salesforce and Gainsight so learning, community, and certification data syncs to the right account and contact records and appears in Customer Success, Sales, and partner workflows, giving a complete picture of adoption, health, and renewal.
* Lead delivery of platform programs end to end: plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor and implementation-partner management, testing, launch, and change management.
* Own the certification and credentialing platform infrastructure, including proctored exams, digital badges, and certification maintenance and renewal flows, in partnership with the Certification team.
* Deliver learning in the flow of work, including in-product guidance within Cornerstone and experiences embedded in the tools customers, partners, and employees already use.
* Set technical priorities for learning system administrators, review configuration decisions, evaluate platform changes, and define release and testing standards.

*Partnership & Leadership*

* Partner with your manager to translate business goals into platform priorities and to report progress and outcomes.
* Work across Cornerstone University, Customer Success, Services, Support, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and IT.
* Act as Customer Zero: run Cornerstone University on Cornerstone products and give structured feedback to Product.
* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.
  

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **First 30-60 days:** current-state map, target-state architecture, prioritized roadmap, and investment case agreed with leadership; quick wins identified and underway.
* **By 6 months:** unified identity and single front door in delivery; agentic experiences serving 60+% of the audience’s needs through agentic front door, learning and community data flowing to Salesforce and Gainsight account records at an agreed data-quality level; telemetry standards in place; first AI experience piloting with defined success metrics.
* **By 9-12 months:** single front door live for customers and partners serving 80+% of the needs; AI answer experience in production with measured resolution and satisfaction; fewer platforms and lower platform cost; learning engagement visible in account health and used by Customer Success; certification infrastructure supporting proctored, role-based credentials at scale.
* **Ongoing measures:** front-door adoption, time to answer, integration reliability, data quality, AI resolution rate, and platform cost, plus clear contribution to customer adoption, retention, and partner readiness.

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 10+ years in learning technology, customer education, or enterprise SaaS platforms, including significant time as a platform owner, product manager, or architect who set strategy, not only configured tools.
* Proven ownership of a multi-platform learning ecosystem. You were accountable for the vision, architecture, integrations, and roadmap across learning, community, knowledge, and certification platforms, with evidence that it improved customer and business outcomes.
* Product management depth: discovery, prioritization, road mapping, business cases, build vs. buy decisions, and adoption metrics.
* A track record of leading large-scale, multi-system implementations or consolidations from strategy through delivery, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
* Deep integration experience across learning systems and Salesforce CRM, including REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data syncs, and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI).
* Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise or customer education LMS, preferably Cornerstone, or Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries, Intellum, Absorb, or similar.
* AI shipped in production: you have designed and delivered at least one AI-powered experience (e.g., agents, RAG-based answers, or AI workflows) used by real users with measured outcomes, and can speak to evaluation, guardrails, data governance, and cost.
* Ability to set strategy independently and communicate it at executive level.
* Comfort moving between strategy and configuration in the same day.
  

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Experience integrating online community platforms (Gainsight preferred), including SSO, data, and how learning and community intersect.
* Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms and customer health data.
* Customer and partner education experience at a B2B SaaS company, including certification programs.
* Experience with agent interoperability standards (such as MCP) and enterprise AI platforms.
* Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Integration Architect).
  

**How You Work:**

* **Customer obsessed:** you start from the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* **Innovate and transform:** you challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that don’t earn their place.
* **Proactive leadership:** you see the problem and act before you’re asked.
* **Get it done:** you ship, measure, and iterate.
* **Forward looking:** you plan for where the technology and the business are going, not where they have been.
* **AI native:** you use AI every day to rethink your own work, not just to speed it up.
* **Get uncomfortable to succeed:** you take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.
  

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Senior Manager, Real-Time Operations and Workforce Management will build and lead a new 24/7 Real-Time Operations Center in Pune, India. This leader will establish the processes, operating rhythms, tools, and team capabilities required to manage intraday workforce performance across a global Support organization.
  
The role combines WFM expertise with strong operational leadership. The Senior Manager will oversee real-time staffing, schedule execution, adherence, shrinkage, queue health, and live customer demand across calls and case work. Using NICE CXone WFM and Salesforce, this leader will ensure emerging risks are identified early, decisions are made quickly, and actions are coordinated with Support leadership, WFM planning, and frontline managers.
  
This leader will also help translate broader Customer Experience priorities and the Operational Rigor framework into practical daily operating mechanisms. The goal is to improve visibility, accountability, service protection, productivity, and customer outcomes while freeing frontline managers to focus on case progression, coaching, quality, employee development, and customer commitments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Real-Time Operations Center Leadership
  

* Build and operationalize the Real-Time Operations Center, including its staffing model, coverage plan, role clarity, shift structure, handoff routines, escalation paths, and management cadences.
* Lead and develop a distributed 24/7 team of Real-Time Operations Specialists, establishing expectations for decision quality, responsiveness, documentation, communication, and customer-impact awareness.
* Create a culture of ownership, urgency, analytical thinking, and disciplined execution in which the Center actively protects service and customer outcomes rather than simply reporting conditions.

Intraday Workforce Management and Service Protection
  

* Oversee intraday monitoring and intervention across global Support operations, including staffing levels, queue conditions, contact volumes, case backlogs, service levels, productivity, occupancy, and emerging demand or capacity gaps.
* Use NICE CXone WFM to monitor schedules against actual activity, manage real-time adherence, identify late starts, absences, extended AUX states, and other deviations, and coordinate approved schedule or coverage changes.
* Establish response playbooks for staffing shortages, unexpected volume, shrinkage events, system disruption, high-priority customer demand, backlog risk, and other business-continuity situations.
* Ensure the Center monitors both live calls and Salesforce case queues so customer demand is managed across channels and work types rather than through a voice-only lens.

Operational Rigor and Process Design
  

* Design and continuously improve standard operating procedures, decision rights, escalation matrices, shift handoffs, incident routines, and evidence-based operating practices for real-time management.
* Partner with WFM leadership to align real-time execution with forecasting, scheduling, skill-group consolidation, shift optimization, heat maps, capacity models, and broader workforce planning.
* Help standardize AUX codes, shrinkage categories, schedule adherence practices, queue definitions, reporting logic, and operational terminology across Support business units.
* Develop dashboards, daily views, interval reporting, and recurring operational communications that create a reliable single source of truth for managers and leaders.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Customer Experience
  

* Partner with Support Services, WFM, Ready, Pro, Pro WFM, Operations, Technology, Product, and other stakeholders to align real-time actions to customer experience priorities and business commitments.
* Translate operational signals into clear recommendations, decisions, and escalations for Support leaders, including the likely effect on customer wait time, case aging, service level, resolution speed, and employee experience.
* Ensure real-time operations are connected to the broader Ops Rigor framework, including customer outcomes, operational health and flow, management routines, governance, and accountability.
* Represent the Real-Time Operations Center in operating reviews and transformation forums, bringing forward patterns, systemic gaps, and opportunities to improve the Support operating model.

Analytics, Governance, and Change Adoption
  

* Define and monitor performance measures such as schedule adherence, shrinkage, occupancy, queue and case service levels, staffing variance, productivity, backlog risk, escalation response, and data quality.
* Establish inspection and review routines that distinguish planned schedules from actual AUX activity and reinforce accurate, timely operational data.
* Lead change adoption for new WFM processes, CXone capabilities, Salesforce operational views, and real-time management routines, ensuring changes are understood and embedded into daily work.
* Use trends and root-cause analysis to recommend improvements to staffing, skills, processes, technology, and cross-functional ownership.

Basic Qualifications
  

* 8+ years of experience in workforce management, contact center operations, customer support operations, real-time management, or a related operational leadership field.
* Demonstrated experience leading intraday or real-time operations in a complex, multi-site, multi-channel contact center or enterprise support environment.
* Strong working knowledge of WFM disciplines, including forecasting and scheduling partnership, real-time adherence, shrinkage, occupancy, staffing variance, service levels, and interval management.
* Experience using NICE CXone WFM, NICE IEX, or a comparable enterprise WFM and ACD platform. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or comparable case-management tooling is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to build operating models, standard operating procedures, escalation frameworks, dashboards, and governance routines from the ground up.
* Strong people leadership, executive communication, analytical reasoning, and decision-making skills in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant WFM, contact center, or operations certification preferred.

  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience launching or transforming a command center, real-time operations center, or centralized intraday management function.
* Experience managing global operations across multiple regions, time zones, languages, channels, skill groups, or business units.
* Experience with workforce capacity models, interval forecasting, heat maps, business-continuity planning, and operational reporting.
* Experience driving change management, workforce discipline, and adoption of standardized operating practices across distributed teams.

  
Success Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate is a builder and operator who can create structure without slowing the business down. This leader combines contact-center WFM expertise with sound judgment, clear communication, and a strong customer lens. They are comfortable making time-sensitive decisions with incomplete information, escalating appropriately, and turning real-time signals into coordinated action. They will be measured not only by the accuracy of reports, but by whether the Center helps Support leaders act earlier, protect customer experience, improve workforce discipline, and create a more predictable operating environment.

We are seeking an experienced Resilience Recovery Engineer - Software to join the Resilience Operations team, working alongside CTO Platform Engineering. * React or Angular front-end development (responsive, accessible UIs).
* Go backend development, including REST API design and service integration.
* GitLab CI/CD pipelines (build, test, scan, deploy automation).

* TypeScript and modern front-end tooling and patterns.

* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.

**Position: Associate Manager – Client Relation**

**Job Location: Pune, India**

**Work Mode- Hybrid**

**Shift Time: 5:00 PM-2:00 AM, 6:00 PM-3:00 AM**

  

**Our journey**

Sakon offers a SaaS platform and services to optimize enterprise mobility expenses, lifecycles, and support. Integrating data from carriers, HR, MDM, and Finance, it streamlines workflows, provides insights, and ensures accurate reporting. Features include invoice auditing, lifecycle management, 24x7 support, and seamless ServiceNow integration. Additional services like MDM administration and BYOD management enhance operations, driving savings and efficiency. Manage mobile investments confidently with Sakon. Learn more at www.sakon.com.

  
  

**The Value We Deliver**

SAKON empowers employees with self-service and real-time updates via a branded portal, app, email, chat, or ServiceNow. It streamlines policy management, optimizes costs, addresses usage issues, and integrates data from carriers, MDM, HR, and Finance. SAKON delivers insights, ensures compliance, and drives efficiency across mobile inventory and expenses.

  
  

**Role Overview/Your Impact**

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Customer Relationship Manager (CRM) to oversee and enhance customer relationships while ensuring a seamless customer experience. This role is critical in driving customer success, ensuring operational excellence, and fostering long-term partnerships that contribute to the organization’s growth objectives.

The ideal candidate will proactively manage risks, improve customer satisfaction, align customer expectations, and maintain effective communication with clients and internal teams. This role requires strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills to drive customer success and business growth.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Risk Management**

* Provide timely updates on business rules to ensure compliance and operational efficiency.

* Monitor escalation trends for all managed services functions and volume patterns for delivery teams to identify potential risks.

* Capture and analyse customer feedback/sentiment to address concerns effectively.

* Identify and resolve subjective operational risks that may impact service delivery for Managed Services.

* Review data to detect and mitigate revenue leakage, ensuring financial integrity.

* Identify communication risks and implement strategies to prevent misunderstandings or misalignment.

**B. Customer Experience**

* Proactively engage with clients to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction.

* Ensure proactive and effective communication with customers to address concerns and set clear expectations.

* Identify process gaps, collaborate with customers to mitigate them, and improve operational workflows.

* Enhance ease of product usage by addressing pain points in collaboration with internal teams.

* Standardize processes, messaging, and interactions across customers for consistency.

* Monitor customer support tickets to ensure that requests and issues raised are addressed promptly.

* Drive improvements in key metrics such as CSAT (Customer Satisfaction Score) and NPS (Net Promoter Score).

**C. Customer Expectations**

* Ensure timeliness for Managed Services Delivery while proactively informing clients of any blockers or delays.

* Maintain high standards for client support response times with clear, effective communication.

* Understand client requirements thoroughly and set realistic expectations to foster trust.

* Take a proactive approach to problem-solving by anticipating issues before they escalate.

**D. Customer & Internal Communication**

* Conduct weekly/monthly client meetings to review progress, address concerns, and strengthen relationships.

* Lead Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and participate in Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to discuss performance metrics, updates, and strategic plans for Managed Services with clients.

* Perform quarterly reviews of business services offered to customer to ensure alignment with client needs.

* Develop and maintain a comprehensive vendor and client communication matrix for streamlined interactions.

* Keep detailed records of client meeting notes as well as internal meeting notes for future reference and action planning.

* Foster collaboration between the CRM team and the Customer Success Management (CSM) team for aligned goals.

**E. Proactive Actions**

* Analyse data trends to uncover actionable insights that can be shared with customers for added value.

* Manage issues/escalations proactively by addressing them before they impact customer relationships or operations.

  
  

**Our Expectations**

* Proven experience in customer relationship management or a related field (e.g., account management, customer success).

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data trends and identify risks or opportunities.

* Excellent communication skills—both verbal and written—to engage effectively with clients at all levels.

* Demonstrated ability to manage escalations, resolve conflicts, and build long-term customer relationships.

* Proficiency in CRM tools/software for tracking client interactions and maintaining records accurately.

* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail for managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

  
  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

1. Improvement in CSAT/NPS scores over time.

2. Timely response and resolution for support requests received.

3. Customer engagement

4. Proactive escalation management.

5. Reduction in escalation volumes – Effectively and timely de-escalating, Ave Response times, through proactive risk management strategies.

6. Timely completion of MBRs/QBRs with actionable outcomes documented clearly.

7. Identification of revenue leakage or process gaps with successful resolution measures implemented.

  
  

**The SAKON Spirit**

At Sakon, teamwork and excellence define our culture. Our diverse team of engineers, telecom experts, and CPAs share a passion for innovation and service. Driven by collaboration, our global teams deliver exceptional customer experiences, combining technical expertise with a human touch to achieve great results with enthusiasm and care.

  
  

**Benefits and Perks**

* Flexible Holiday Policy (choose your own holidays)

* Hybrid Working Options

* Life & Medical Insurance

* Focus on Skill Development, Re-imbursement for Certifications

* Wifi-Mobile bill reimbursement

* Employee well-being activities

To apply, kindly share the resume with talentacquistion@sakon.com.

If your profile is shortlisted, you will be invited to complete a communication test followed by interviews.

* Good understanding of concurrency and multithreading concepts
* LLD: modular architecture, clean abstractions, component design

* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.

* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: Value Realization Manager
description:
**Who are we?**


Checkmarx is the leader in application security and ensures that enterprises worldwide can secure their application development from code to cloud. Our consolidated platform and services address the needs of enterprises by improving security and reducing TCO, while simultaneously building trust between AppSec, developers, and CISOs. At Checkmarx, we believe it’s not just about *finding risk but* *remediating* it across the entire application footprint and software supply chain with one seamless process for all relevant stakeholders.


We are honored to serve more than 1,800 customers, which includes 40 percent of all Fortune 100 companies, including Siemens, Airbus, Salesforce, Stellantis, Adidas, Wal\-Mart, and Sanofi.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a \*\*Value Realization Manager\*\* to join our Revenue Operations team. This is a newly created role focused on one clear mission: making sure the GTM technology we've invested in—Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar GTM platforms—actually delivers the business outcomes it was purchased for.


You'll sit at the intersection of RevOps, Sales Enablement, and Vendor Management. Rather than just administering tools, you'll own the \*value\* they generate: adoption, ROI, workflow efficiency, and measurable impact on pipeline and revenue. If you've spent time as a customer success manager on the vendor side of GTM tech and are ready to apply that customer success discipline internally, this role is built for you.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own the end\-to\-end value realization strategy for our core GTM tech stack (Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and call recorder tools such as Kaia or Clari Copilot)
* Define and track adoption metrics, usage benchmarks, and ROI models for each platform; report regularly to RevOps and Sales leadership
* Partner with Sales, Sales Enablement, Business Application, and IT teams to ensure tools are configured, integrated, and used the way they were intended
* Identify underutilized features or workflows and drive targeted enablement to close the gap
* Act as the internal "CSM" for each vendor relationship—running regular business reviews, escalating issues, and holding vendors accountable to their own value promises
* Build and maintain a value realization scorecard/dashboard that ties tool usage to pipeline, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity outcomes
* Lead onboarding and change management for new tool rollouts or major feature releases
* Gather qualitative and quantitative feedback from sales reps and managers to continuously improve stack ROI
* Serve as the primary point of contact for renewal and expansion conversations, providing usage data and value evidence to inform commercial decisions

  

Requirements:
  

* 3\+ years of experience in customer success, revenue operations, sales enablement, or a related GTM function
* Direct hands\-on experience with at least 2 of the following: Call Recorder Tool, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Strong communication and presentation skills—comfortable in front of sales reps, frontline managers, and executive leadership alike
* Strong analytical skills—comfortable building dashboards, interpreting usage data, and translating numbers into a business narrative
* Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence sales leaders and reps without direct authority

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Prior experience as a \*\*Customer Success Manager at Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn—you know these tools from the vendor side and understand how to extract maximum value from them
* Familiarity with GTM tech stack architecture and how these tools integrate with each other and with Salesforce/HubSpot
